purpose: Active OZM recurring failure family registry. It prevents repeated field failures from being handled only as hardening-log prose.

governance.rule: Each active family must have an owner child, route rule, eval case, prevention gate, and claim effect before it can be considered covered.
governance.nonGoal: This registry does not replace child SKILL.md rules, route-rules.json, eval cases, guards, or project-specific control docs.

activeFamilies.problem: Route output or pre-compaction receipts are mistaken for current-turn child SKILL.md hydration.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Actual child SKILL.md hydration must be reconstructed after the latest compaction boundary before execution, audit consumption, closeout, or positive wording.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: child_skill_hydration_missing keeps evidence navigation-only until owner children are loaded.

activeFamilies.problem: A review/subagent/audit PASS is consumed, then controller/control surfaces are mutated and final closeout treats the old PASS as if it covered the final state.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Any control-surface mutation after the latest PASS needs focused rereview, final control-surface audit, or an explicit record-sync-only/lowered ceiling before closeout.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: stale-pass-after-control-mutation limits final-state wording to pending-controller-gate or record-sync-only until the final state is reviewed.

activeFamilies.problem: Current-phase-only wording suppresses mandatory companion children during control writes, audit use, closeout, next-packet admission, or positive claims.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Treat current-phase child as primary owner only; add support children when the next action crosses their ownership.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Missing companion children block acceptance, controller consumption, and positive progress wording.

activeFamilies.problem: External-prerequisite diagnostic or fallback admission updates queue/current-state/report records without dispatch, record, closeout, and claim owners.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Control-surface admission from prerequisite work must freeze write-set, record sync, stop state, and claim ceiling.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Prerequisite readback can support diagnostic/fallback posture only until companion gates run.

activeFamilies.problem: Scoped phrases such as 'do not implement provider source' are misread as global plan-only and suppress an authorized controller update.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Separate request role from subject/action constraints; preserve subject routing while applying read-only role only when it is global.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Global read-only blocks execution; scoped forbidden action narrows the write-set without closing admitted controller work.

activeFamilies.problem: OZM control surfaces remain dominant after the task should be domain/source/runtime led, and auto-loop wording becomes an interface instead of an evaluator method.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Freeze dynamic control-plane weight, control-noise budget, evaluator method, bounded packet grain, and method-reset trigger before continuation.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Loop progress is packet-scoped and cannot cross role, method, or claim gates just because standing autonomy exists.

activeFamilies.problem: Long loops repeatedly refresh proof wrappers, hashes, audit receipts, or full gates after low-semantic-change edits.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Classify change class, gate tier, invalidation inputs, stable evidence versus volatile navigation, full-gate trigger, and append-only audit receipt behavior.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Scoped/evidence-sync gates can support iteration; acceptance claims still require the frozen full-gate trigger.

activeFamilies.problem: Reference-guided work reaches route/name/policy parity but lacks runtime capability depth, negative paths, state/data-flow behavior, or source-backed gap reduction.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Build reference maps, Paper Method Cards when papers govern execution, source-backed gap ledger, target truth runtime map, adoption matrix, execution anchors, anti-transplant constraints, and node-level depth floor before writer admission.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Progress claims must reduce a source-backed reference gap or stay support/local/candidate only.

activeFamilies.problem: Paper or reference methodology is analyzed once, then later packets proceed without method atoms, execution anchors, source-backed gap ledger rows, or drift sentinel checks.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Paper/reference methods must compile into method cards, adoption contracts, gap ledgers, packet anchors, drift sentinels, and closeout gap transitions before they can govern execution.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Missing anchors or unchanged gaps lower claims to background_only, support_only, local_truth_only, surface-prototype, or reference-depth-candidate.

activeFamilies.problem: Writer or execution records modify Plan/Goal/master-plan/contracts to fit partial implementation, lowering requirements or self-validating results.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Separate controller-truth docs from execution records; ordinary writer records candidate controller deltas and re-dispatches after accepted controller changes.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Plan/Goal edits by writer lanes lower acceptance and require controller-update closeout.

activeFamilies.problem: Governed text artifacts become source summaries or confident prose without draft research, unknown-unknown discovery, claim/evidence mapping, reader/editor issue closure, or closed-loop receipt.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Text drafting requires draft intake, research/question bank, concept/unknown ledger when needed, claim-evidence-argument matrix, draft issue registry, reader/editor verdict, and draft closed-loop receipt.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Without evidence rows and issue-to-delta-to-verdict closure, text stays draft_candidate, evidence_incomplete, shallow_summary_only, or review_pending.

activeFamilies.problem: Versions, packet ids, unit ids, run ids, local paths, or claim wording leak into active source/config/data/UI/deployment surfaces.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Freeze active hygiene posture at dispatch and run active non-planning surface sweep before clean-baseline or deployment/maintenance claims.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Clean-baseline, maintainer-safe, or deployment-safe claims stay lowered until active residue is fixed or explicitly scoped.

activeFamilies.problem: OZM grows by accumulating repeated one-off fixes without a structured recurrence family, route rule, eval, and guard-backed prevention path.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: New repeated OZM defects must land as a registry family or link to an existing one before adding more active prose.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Skill-hardening claims remain candidate until registry, route, eval, and guard checks agree.

activeFamilies.problem: A broad route keyword suppresses lexical/tag seed candidates, or a skill is counted as effective after route/load mention without downstream artifacts, blockers, receipts, script posture, or claim effect.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Low-confidence route rules may not suppress strong seed matches; activation audits must require an effect contract and downstream binding before positive skill-effectiveness wording.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Skill effectiveness stays diagnostic when evidence is route-only, load-only, missing artifacts, missing script/downgrade, or unconsumed by downstream owners.

activeFamilies.problem: Evo/self-improving-agent lessons, LLM API judgments, or single-trace improvements are promoted into active OZM behavior without candidate lifecycle, heldout/regression eval, rollback, or owner claim ceiling.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Capability evolution must create candidate/eval/promotion/rollback records; LLM API output is optional candidate evidence and cannot promote or execute changes by itself.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Evolution claims stay at evolution_candidate, eval_incomplete, or api_evaluator_only until baseline, heldout/regression, review, rollback, and promotion receipt pass.

activeFamilies.problem: Standalone external reviewer skills are routed or loaded as independent authorities in OZM-governed work, causing duplicate review surfaces, acceptance ambiguity, and missing claim-ceiling handoff.
activeFamilies.prevention_gate: Route OZM-governed expert review through ozm-expert-review-suite; archived reviewer ids are donor history only and cannot produce pass/accepted wording directly.
activeFamilies.claim_effect: Expert findings remain candidate evidence until OZM review, closeout, and claim-ceiling owners consume them.
